title: Monkey Man
content: I woke up in hospital bed, a screen opened infront of me but it wasn’t a screen more like a window everything felt so familiar like I’d been there before but looking around everything looked like the color scheme of a set like you’d see on a tv show like muted colors , anyone infront of me is a man, in a 3 pc red velvet suit, no shirt under chest out real hairy,dark skin Indian or middle eastern, shoulder length hair, felt like I knew him, he looked normal all except his mouth, had the bottom half mouth like a chipm or monkey maybe? Anyway I didn’t want to be rude and felt like he could read my thoughts anyway so I ask why he was so hairy and he laughed…. I knew wherever I was had been there before. I call it TV land. I don’t know. He was in some flying machine over water it was a round metal circle like a bike with a circle around it over water…. I think about this particular dream a lot bc all the other ones slip anyway this one is the only one I can remember so vividly… Anyone else?
